content.title: About
content.content: Red Bull is a popular energy drink created in Austria in 1987. It contains caffeine, taurine, B‑vitamins, and sugar (in the classic version). The drink is marketed as a way to boost alertness, concentration, and physical endurance.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Red Bull was inspired by the Thai energy drink “Krating Daeng”.
The brand heavily sponsors extreme sports, Formula 1 racing, and music festivals.
In the 2020s Red Bull became the first beverage to be an official sponsor of the Tokyo Olympic Games.
A 250 ml can contains about 80 mg of caffeine – roughly the same as a cup of regular coffee.
Red Bull offers sugar‑free, caffeine‑free, and “Energy Shot” 60 ml variants.

items.title: Increased alertness
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, improving focus and reducing feelings of fatigue.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: B‑vitamins (B6, B12, niacin, pyridoxine) play key roles in energy metabolism, helping convert food into usable energy.

items.title: Enhanced physical endurance
items.content: Taurine may help muscles use oxygen more efficiently during intense activity.

items.title: Excessive caffeine intake
items.content: High caffeine doses can cause anxiety, insomnia, rapid heartbeat, and increased blood pressure.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: The classic version contains about 27 g of sugar, which can contribute to weight gain and dental caries if consumed frequently.

items.title: Not recommended for children and pregnant women
items.content: Due to its high caffeine and stimulant levels, the drink is not advised for people under 18, pregnant or nursing women.

items.title: Interaction with medications
items.content: Caffeine may amplify the effects of certain drugs, especially central nervous system stimulants.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Red Bull is typically consumed chilled, straight from the can. It is recommended to limit intake to 1‑2 cans (250‑500 ml) per day and avoid mixing with alcohol.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, consume within 24 hours for best taste.
